headline: Committee backs Bill 141, shifting tech park land to housing

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: The committee voted to recommend Bill 141, which shifts some tech park commercial land to housing while keeping a 1,250-unit cap.
meeting.recap: A testifier asked about safe parking for people in need near the police station at the tech park.[[0:13:23]] The same testifier asked to defer the item until after the election.[[0:16:03]] The main item was Bill 141 (2026), which would amend the county code chapter for the Maui Research and Technology Park.[[0:18:53]] The cap of 1,250 housing units would not change.[[0:26:21]] The planning director said the county will study where to put a South Maui transit hub.[[0:36:03]] The chair said the residential area would grow from 102.3 acres to 158 acres.[[0:43:45]] The committee voted eight ayes, no noes, with one member excused, to recommend passing Bill 141 on first reading.[[0:45:30]]
meeting.next: After the recess, the committee will move on to its next agenda item.

issues.oneLine: Bill 141 would move some Maui Research and Technology Park land to the residential district while keeping the same number of homes.
issues.brief: The residential district would grow from 102.3 acres to 158 acres.[[#1]] The cap of 1,250 residential units stays the same.[[#2]] The committee voted eight ayes, no noes, with one excused, to recommend passing the bill on first reading.[[#3]]
